title: Towards Optimal Policy Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2610.01566v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Practical Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms learn to solve Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) through iterative policy improvement in the presence of approximate evaluation. We study policy improvement from first principles, defining optimal policy improvement as producing the best policy attainable in a single update under specified constraints. We show that optimal improvement restricted to a set of states is equivalent to solving an induced MDP, characterizing planning with an explicit or implicit model as a path towards optimal policy improvement. Because practical methods commonly solve such induced problems through iterative improvement in the form of greedification, we take steps towards optimal greedification under the central practical constraint of approximate evaluation. We formulate greedification under this constraint as probabilistic decision-making under uncertainty and derive a novel operator that is optimal with respe

translated_abstract: 实用的强化学习（RL）算法在存在近似评估的情况下，通过迭代策略改进来学习求解马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。我们从第一性原理出发研究策略改进，将最优策略改进定义为在指定约束下单次更新所能产生的最佳策略。我们证明，限制在一组状态上的最优改进等价于求解一个由此诱导出的MDP，从而将使用显式或隐式模型的规划刻画为通往最优策略改进的一条路径。由于实用方法通常通过以贪心化形式进行的迭代改进来求解此类诱导问题，我们在近似评估这一核心实际约束下，朝着最优贪心化迈出了步伐。我们将该约束下的贪心化表述为不确定性下的概率决策，并推导出一个在此意义下最优的新型算子……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文从第一性原理定义了最优策略改进，证明其等价于求解诱导MDP，并在近似评估约束下将贪心化表述为不确定性下的概率决策，据此推导出一个最优的新型算子。
en_tdlr: This paper defines optimal policy improvement from first principles, shows its equivalence to solving an induced MDP, and formulates greedification under approximate evaluation as probabilistic decision-making under uncertainty, deriving a novel optimal operator.
